events.headline: US and Iran negotiators explore a phased deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, sending Brent crude down from recent highs; supply remains constrained after Saudi East-West pipeline attacks and a near-record-low US SPR
Trump and Xi meet in Washington and agree to extend the US-China trade truce to Jan. 10; China agrees to suspend rare-earth export controls and the US trims some tariffs, easing supply-chain risk

10-year Treasury yield hits its highest level since 2007 (~5.2%) and the 30-year its highest since 2004 (~5.5%) after New York Fed President Williams says another rate hike is 'reasonable' by year-end, following the Fed's mid-September hike to 3.75%-4.00%
AMD crosses $1 trillion market value and chipmakers rally as AI accelerator demand stays strong; Nvidia posted 106% YoY revenue growth last quarter with Data Center revenue up 117%

Drone carrying explosives found near a Ukrainian cargo aircraft at Leipzig/Halle Airport in Germany; Poland says it thwarted a Russian-backed assassination attempt, while the US Senate narrowly rejected forcing an end to the Iran war without congressional authorization
